scope: Only author architecture, example configurations and license retained. configs.py is an upstream example, NOT our executable evaluator: it supplies a 4D input but archs.py requires B,T,C,H,W. Repository has no training/recursive-evaluation entry or weights in this pinned tree. Our qualification uses the released XS architecture at 384x384 with a 5D pair; no paper performance reproduction or method novelty is claimed.
constraints: Fixed576 token mixers; arbitrary-size native enhancement is not supported by simply changing img_size.
Recurrence initial prediction is specified as GT in paper v1; any self-start deployment evaluation must be labeled an adaptation.
Config XS is code-release configuration, not a verified table of the formal WACV final paper.
Do not invoke configs.py .cuda() example in shared server; use prebound admission for any future GPU work.
